shots.prompt: POV doorstep shot. A cold unbranded glass jar of thick white yogurt sits in a modern grey insulated delivery bag on a sunlit wooden apartment doorstep in Zurich. A hand reaches down and lifts the jar slowly toward camera. Warm morning sunlight, gentle lens flare, upscale clean residential entrance, condensation on the cold glass.
